children: RECENTLY DISCLOSED INVESTIGATION INTO COMPANY IS STILL ONGOING, AND THE COMPANY WILL FULLY COOPERATE WITH TAIWAN PROSECUTORS

COMPANY'S DISCLOSURE STATEMENT CAME AFTER TAIWAN PROSECUTORS SAID ON SATURDAY THEY HAD SEARCHED ITS OFFICES ON SUSPICION THE COMPANY FALSELY LABELED SOME OF ITS CHINA-MADE PRODUCTS AS BEING FROM TAIWAN
THE PRODUCTS IN QUESTION ARE PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARDS, NOT SUBSTRATES
SEES NO SIGNIFICANT FINANCIAL IMPACT OF THE INVESTIGATION ON THE COMPANY, AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS ARE CONTINUING AS NORMAL
